notes: Checked: main header mega-menu (site-nav dropdowns + mobile slide-nav), homepage hero/footer banners, full /collections.json sweep (270 collections, all pages), sitemap_collections_1.xml (confirms indexed/live pages), robots.txt (clean, no Claude-specific disallow, standard Shopify crawl rules, accessed via direct HTTP requests, no WAF issues encountered this pass). Target-term matches found: 'Best Selling' (handle best-selling, 13 products) and 'TRENDING DECOR' (handle trending-back-in-stock, 21 products) -- neither is currently linked from the main nav or homepage, but both are live, publicly reachable, sitemapped collection pages with real product grids. See flag on row 2 for why Trending Decor is ambiguous. Excluded after inspection: 'Popular Dinnerware' (handle popular-dinnerware, the site's own products_count field claimed 9 products, but exhaustive /products.json enumeration and the rendered page both show 0 products -- dropped per the zero-product rule). 'Deal of The Day' (deal-of-the-day, 5 products) -- a generic time-bound promo with no popularity/bestseller wording in title or copy, excluded. Also reviewed and excluded as non-matching: Art Bash, CRED Offer tiers, Diwali Offer tiers, Summer Sale family, Valentine's Day Sale family, Freedom Sale, Rakhi Special, Friday Deals/Sales family, Shop Under X price tiers, Gift For Her/Him, Cred Reward tiers -- all generic seasonal/promotional/price-tier/gifting collections carrying no Bestsellers/Top Sellers/Popular/Trending/Customer Favorites wording. No 'Top Sellers', 'Customer Favorites', or 'Most Popular' named page exists anywhere on the site. Per the prior Home-Decor pass's confirmed finding for this exact site, the Shopify 'products_count' field is consistently inflated vs the exhaustive /products.json id enumeration (e.g. best-selling: field said 32, enumeration=13; trending-back-in-stock: field said 22, enumeration=21); every qty below is the enumerated value, independently confirmed against the rendered page's own '<N> products' header text.
